summary: Iteration 4: verified full dynamic-data refactor. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (health, users CRUD, applications, saved toggle, opportunities list with 10 seeded records + required fields, single opportunity get + 404, personalised score deterministic and skill-driven, sort by score desc, updating user.skills changes subsequent scores). Frontend: student demo login flow, /home dynamic match (89% not 94%) with strongestSkill=React, nextSkill=Python, 3 personalised opportunity cards; /dashboard 4 dynamic stat cards + 4 skill-line rows; /opportunities lists 10 with working search (React -> 3 results); /opportunities/frontend-intern detail-score=99%; bad id shows detail-not-found; /skill-match score matches share-card; /profile shows Aarav/AM/90%; /my-applications redirects; edit-profile add 'Python' -> dashboard immediately shows skill-line-python and new-matches count changes (04->05). Zero console errors, no 'Oppo is not defined'.
critical_code_review_comments: computeScore is duplicated in frontend (App.js) and backend (server.py _match_score). Deterministic + identical formula, but any future tweak requires updating both. Acceptable trade-off since frontend also recomputes locally for instant response after skill edit before API refresh.

Home overallMatch = mean(top-3 personalised scores). Adding a skill that boosts a mid-tier opportunity without displacing the top-3 leaves home-match-score unchanged (observed 89% before and after adding Python for Aarav). This is mathematically correct — dashboard skill-breakdown and new-matches count DID recompute in the same edit — but the review-request wording 'Home page match score MUST change on next render' can be misleading. Consider basing overallMatch on top-5 or user-skill coverage for stronger visible feedback.
App.js is a single 233-line file with all routes; still manageable but nearing the split threshold if more features are added.

Frontend caches opportunities in localStorage (skillbridge_opps_cache) — good offline UX, but stale cached scores may render for a brief moment on cold load before the /opportunities?email= refetch resolves.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 9 pytest cases across two files. Personalised scoring uses deterministic overlap formula; identical function on frontend (computeScore) and backend (_match_score). SkillbridgeProvider fetches /api/opportunities?email= on user.email or skills length change and re-derives overallMatch, skillBreakdown, nextSkill, strongestSkill via useMemo. All required data-testids from the review request are present and populated dynamically.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Refactor from static hardcoded values (94%, React strong/TypeScript next) to dynamic computed values is complete and working end-to-end.
